gates.balance_chain: RUN ACROSS ALL THREE STAPLED REPORTS AND AGAINST CHUNK DOCUMENT 09c79b79 - and it exposes a real convention error by the filer, which no single-page arithmetic could see. (1) Report 1 closes EXACTLY: balance LAST 9,419.85 minus expenses 1,286.75 = 8,133.10 = its balance THIS and CUMULATIVE cells (contributions are 0 this period). (2) Report 3 closes exactly on its own face: 9,419.00 + 2,250.00 = 11,669.00 on line 1; 1,286.00 + 0 = 1,286.00 on line 3; 8,133.00 + 2,250.00 = 10,383.00 on line 4. (3) BUT report 3's line-1 LAST cell (9,419.00) is NOT report 1's contributions cumulative, which is 0 - it is report 1's BALANCE-brought-forward 9,419.85, rounded down to whole dollars. The filer is carrying the balance figure forward on the CONTRIBUTIONS line, and rounds every carried figure to the dollar (1,286.75 -> 1,286.00; 8,133.10 -> 8,133.00). (4) The chain to report 2 runs through the BALANCE column, not the contributions column: report 3's balance cumulative 10,383.00 is exactly report 2's line-1 LAST cell of 10,383, while report 3's contributions cumulative 11,669 appears nowhere on report 2. (5) Report 2's own balance line does not close exactly (20,633 - 1,658.18 = 18,974.82 against a printed 18,975, an 0.18 rounding). Every figure is retained verbatim; nothing was recomputed or overwritten.

notes: index.csv says 'Kenneth Adam Snow' / 'Commission Seat C', n_reports 3. CONFIRMED AT THE PAGES: the PDF staples THREE reports and every cover's name line reads Kenneth Adam Snow; the office lines read 'Commission' (reports 1 and 3) and 'Commission' (report 2) - THE SEAT LETTER 'C' IS ON NO PAGE OF THE DOCUMENT. A county office, in scope. THE THREE REPORTS ARE OUT OF CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER, exactly the trap the addendum flags: pages 1-3 are the FIRST period (1/1/24-6/18/24), pages 4-6 are the LAST period (10/28/24-12/31/24), pages 7-9 are the MIDDLE period (6/18/2024-10/28/2024). report_no follows PDF page order per contract, so report_no 2 is chronologically last and report_no 3 chronologically second - stated here so no consumer infers order from the number. THREE DIFFERENT FORM PRINTS IN ONE PDF: report 1 is generation 2 (colour 'AMERICA'S COUNTY' logo, three-line cover, handwritten, with the filer's entries marked in yellow highlighter); report 2 is generation 3 (the 'WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE' print with the numbered 1-4 cover and the dense ~40-line schedules); report 3 is generation 2 again (greyscale logo, three-line cover, entirely TYPED). CROSS-CHANNEL RE-POST CONFIRMED, NOT ASSUMED: pages 4-6 are PIXEL-IDENTICAL to chunk document 09c79b79 (raw/live_outpost/Adam Snow - Commission Seat C-Final_01-06-2025.pdf) - a full-page 200 dpi difference over all three pages returns mean 0.0 and max 0. Per addendum §D both are transcribed and neither is skipped; the module should flag the pair downstream. TWO FINDINGS A HUMAN SHOULD LOOK AT. (a) DOUBLE-REPORTED CONTRIBUTIONS: report 3 (period ending 10/28/24) itemizes Stephen Studdert 250.00 and the Washington County Republican Central Committee 2,000.00; report 2 (period beginning 10/28/24) itemizes the SAME two contributions again as 'Steve Studdert' 250 and 'Washington County RP' 2,000 - so the same 2,250.00 appears on two consecutive reports. The dates disagree too: report 3 dates Studdert 10/15/2024, report 2 dates him 10-24-24. Both are transcribed verbatim from their own faces; no row was suppressed. (b) VENDOR IDENTITY: report 1 line 4 clearly reads 'Beehive State Consulting' for Campaign Consulting, while report 2 line 5 reads 'Boehire Consulting' for Campaign Consulting at low confidence. That is suggestive of one vendor, but a sibling document is not evidence about a glyph, so neither read was changed - flagged for a human. Privacy: report 2's cover prints the candidate's street address, city, ZIP, email and phone, and every Form A address cell across reports 2 and 3 carries a full street address or PO box plus ZIP - ALL DISCARDED at read time; only city and state tokens are kept.
